top_signals.title: Fmr. Fed Governor Betsy Duke on CPI Amid Bank Results
top_signals.summary: Betsy Duke, Former Fed governor and Former Wells Fargo Chair, says investors should pay closest attention to Fed officials’ comments this week. She argues that a single economic data point is unlikely to shift the outlook significantly, noting that Kevin Morris has emphasized watching trends rather than any one reading. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
